exit: 0
--- stdout
Read a flat CXF document into the authoring form.

Stdout is the sequence as canonical text (the wire form with --wire), exit 0. With -o it is written to a file and stdout is the JSON report, which lists what the importer read and did not carry. A document the importer refuses is exit 2 with the report. The sequence is not validated: run validate or emit on the result.

Usage: oce import [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          The flat CXF document, or `-` for stdin

Options:
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Write the sequence here (atomically) and print the report on stdout; `-` is stdout. The name must not read as another form (.oce is text, .json is wire, .jsonld and .cxf.json are CXF) and must not be the input file

      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

      --wire
          Write the wire form (strict JSON) instead of the text form

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
